cells.scene: A sequence of three handmade cart designs gradually improves from a rough wooden frame to a sturdy wheeled cart, small incremental changes rather than a sudden jump.
A domineering manager brusquely issues orders from a raised chair while dismissing a worker's suggestion with a sharp raised hand.
A worker attempting a basic assembly task produces a crooked unstable stool, confused expression and unused instructions beside it.
A cleaner scrubs so enthusiastically that water splashes over already clean surfaces, coworkers gently signal to slow down.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — evolve (v.逐渐形成): A sequence of three handmade cart designs gradually improves from a rough wooden frame to a sturdy wheeled cart, small incremental changes rather than a sudden jump.
TOP RIGHT — high-handed (a.高压的，专横的): A domineering manager brusquely issues orders from a raised chair while dismissing a worker's suggestion with a sharp raised hand.
BOTTOM LEFT — incompetent (a.不够格的，不称职的): A worker attempting a basic assembly task produces a crooked unstable stool, confused expression and unused instructions beside it.
BOTTOM RIGHT — over-zealously (ad.过分热情地): A cleaner scrubs so enthusiastically that water splashes over already clean surfaces, coworkers gently signal to slow down.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: cart designs gradually evolve; domineering superior dismisses suggestion; incompetent worker makes unstable stool; cleaner works over-zealously while colleagues signal restraint. Appropriate actions, plausible anatomy and crop safety.
